'''Nagem Dr'Lar's salvage team''' was a salvage team led by the [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Nagem Dr'Lar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the team was on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] collecting debris from the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] when they were attacked by [[Osae Meilea]], a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] in the service of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]].
